symbols.name: smaller-call count
symbols.meaning: The total number of smaller calls made by one call of the recursion.
symbols.quote: Here $s$ is the total number of smaller calls made by one call.

symbols.name: stream shrink factor
symbols.meaning: The factor by which the volume of each stream shrinks, so each smaller call receives 1/W of the volume.
symbols.quote: Here $W$ is the factor by which the stream volume shrinks, so each smaller call works on a stream of $1/W$ of the volume.

symbols.name: label space dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of the fixed space from which the subspace labels are drawn.
symbols.quote: Here $m$ is the dimension of the fixed space from which the labels are drawn.

relations.quote: The network attaches [subspace labels](subspace-labels.md) to its gates and terminals.
The network is based on [linear networks and frames](linear-network-frames.md).
